#!/bin/bash

# Pines definidos (líneas BCM)
SX1302_RESET_PIN=23
SX1302_POWER_EN_PIN=18
SX1261_RESET_PIN=22
AD5338R_RESET_PIN=13

CHIP=gpiochip0

echo "Reset SX1302 (GPIO$SX1302_RESET_PIN)"
gpioset $CHIP $SX1302_RESET_PIN=1
sleep 0.1
gpioset $CHIP $SX1302_RESET_PIN=0
sleep 0.1

echo "Reset SX1261 (GPIO$SX1261_RESET_PIN)"
gpioset $CHIP $SX1261_RESET_PIN=1
sleep 0.1
gpioset $CHIP $SX1261_RESET_PIN=0
sleep 0.1

echo "Reset AD5338R (GPIO$AD5338R_RESET_PIN)"
gpioset $CHIP $AD5338R_RESET_PIN=1
sleep 0.1
gpioset $CHIP $AD5338R_RESET_PIN=0
sleep 0.1

echo "Enable SX1302 Power (GPIO$SX1302_POWER_EN_PIN)"
gpioset $CHIP $SX1302_POWER_EN_PIN=1
